# möbius for macOS 0.10.24

- Still bundles gateway 0.16.42; protocol 95 and persisted-state formats are unchanged.
- Icons use thicker strokes.
- Send, dictate and other filled buttons use the vivid accent colour. The White accent follows the text colour, so it turns near-black in light mode, and button labels stay readable against the fill.
- Notifications appear one at a time at the top centre, with a coloured symbol and just the message. Swipe up (scroll up on a trackpad) to dismiss one; errors and warnings wait their turn instead of replacing each other. The extra "File deleted." notice is gone.
- Opening an image in the side pane no longer flashes while the pane slides in.
- Reassign Bot uses the outlined Bot face.
